same_behavior_diff_function: STM-0446 (c14) vs STM-0704 (c7): near-identical behavior ('I avoid difficult conversations' / '...because they're exhausting'). Same role (Likely Maintains) and near-identical function, but c14 is mapped Cross-Phase / 'None available (source gap)' while c7 is mapped Integration / Communication -> Conflict Navigation. The same behavior is grounded in a real competency in c7 but left ungrounded in c14 (inconsistent task+competency treatment).

STM-0055 (c3) vs STM-1085 (c27): near-identical 'I keep my guard up' behavior, both Context Dependent / Discernment with materially the same function and alternative, but mapped to DIFFERENT competencies: c3 = Emotional Intimacy -> Gradual Self-Disclosure, c27 = Trust -> Reliability. Inconsistent competency mapping for the same behavior.

STM-0449 (c14) vs STM-0985 (c23): identical text 'I pretend everything is okay.' Role and function are CONSISTENT here (both Likely Maintains, Cross-Phase, avoid-hard-talk function) -- flagged only because the adaptive alternatives diverge sharply (see inconsistent_alternatives). Not a function/role violation.
inconsistent_alternatives: STM-0449 (c14) vs STM-0985 (c23), identical behavior 'I pretend everything is okay': c14 alt = 'When something is not okay, say so in a simple, honest way' (unconditional, to anyone, no observation step). c23 alt = 'name one true thing to one safe person... watch how it feels and how they answer' PLUS context condition 'about being honest with a safe person, not telling everyone everything.' Same behavior, materially inconsistent alternatives -- one is conditional/observational, the other is a blanket 'be honest' instruction.

Near-duplicate 'always the one who raises hard things' (STM-0078 c7 vs STM-0595 c10) alternatives are CONSISTENT (both = name the pattern, leave room to see if partner initiates); noted only to confirm this pair did NOT diverge.
generic_advice: STM-0449 (c14) adaptive_alternative_1: 'When something is not okay, say so in a simple, honest way.' This is a generic 'just be honest' instruction with no conditionality, no observation/watch step, and no competency anchor (Cross-Phase, 'None available'). Contrast STM-0985 which anchors the same behavior with a 'safe person' condition and a watch step. Closest thing in the dataset to the prohibited unconditional cliche.

c14 Play 'Say the honest thing instead of keeping the peace' new_play: 'Pick one true thing and say it in a calm, kind, and clear way.' Generic assertiveness ('speak up') with no observation loop and no competency (Cross-Phase gap, already review_flagged). Borderline-generic but flagged.

NOTE (not a violation): the reciprocity-pacing alternatives -- 'Give more only as they show more' (c5) and 'Match your giving to what comes back' (c15) -- sit close to the prohibited 'match their energy' cliche, but are properly anchored to Reciprocity / Partnership competencies and stated conditionally, so they read as legitimate. Flagging for author awareness only.
unsupported_mechanisms: STM-0052 (c3) and STM-0782 (c3) 'I leave before they leave' / 'I leave before I can be left': alternatives instruct 'name the fear behind it' / 'name the fear driving it,' presupposing FEAR as the motive. This edges toward an attachment/psychology mechanism (the exact 'fear of being left' motive the rulings warn against). Arguably supported by 'before they leave' in the text, so borderline -- but functions stayed behavioral while the alternatives assert the motive. Low severity / PLAUSIBLE.

STM-0357 (c16) function: 'Looking for signs helps you feel like you are watching for danger instead of sitting with not knowing.' Mildly asserts an internal emotional purpose (vigilance feeling / tolerating uncertainty) rather than a strictly behavioral function; cluster-supported (post-betrayal) so low severity.
over_consolidated_plays: c5 Play 'Notice if they show up before you give more' (STM-0042, STM-0395, STM-0396): merges PURSUIT behaviors (chasing/dating unavailable people) with a SELECTION behavior (STM-0396 'I ignore people who would probably treat me well'). The single new_play 'give more only as they show more' fits chasing but not 0396, whose own per-behavior alt is 'give it more time before you decide.' Different behavioral targets AND different adaptive responses -- author self-flagged ('consolidation spans selection + pursuit').

c11 Play 'Look at what is real, not what you hope for' (STM-0689 + STM-0695): merges two different targets -- passive waiting ('keep waiting for things to get better') and cognitive excuse-making ('keep making excuses for them') -- with two different adaptive moves stapled into one new_play ('look at what has really changed' + 'when you catch yourself making an excuse, name what actually happened'). Violates refinement 8's 'same target AND same adaptive response.'

c3 Play 'Let closeness build a little at a time' folds STM-0307 ('I don't know why I keep pulling away', competency Conflict Management -> Reflection, individual alt = pause and name what happened right before, watch the pattern) into a disclosure-based play whose new_play is 'share one small, true thing.' 0307's adaptive response is observational/reflective, not self-disclosure -- a mild target/response mismatch inside the consolidation.

MILDER: c14 'Say the honest thing instead of keeping the peace' absorbs STM-0447 'I apologize too much' (whose specific per-behavior alt is 'save sorry for when you really did something wrong') into a generic 'say one true thing' play, losing the stop-over-apologizing response. c22 'Let things unfold before you manage them' merges STM-0949 (needing a plan/control) with STM-0953 (defensive pessimism/bracing) -- related but distinct targets.
duplicative_plays_across_clusters: c7 'Notice if raising hard things is shared' (STM-0078) and c10 'Share who starts the hard talks' (STM-0595): SAME target (always the only one who brings up hard conversations) and essentially the SAME new_play (name the pattern, leave room to see if the partner ever initiates). Strong duplicate -- should be cross-referenced/shared.

c3 'Ask straight out instead of testing' (STM-0660, STM-0780) and c6 'Ask for what you need instead of testing' (STM-1054): SAME target (secret testing) and SAME new_play (name what you need, ask directly, watch over time). Duplicate across clusters.

c3 'Let closeness build a little at a time' (includes STM-0055 guard) and c27 'Let your guard down in small steps to see who is safe' (STM-1085): overlapping target and response ('guard up -> lower it in small safe ways and watch how they treat you'). Duplicate/overlap across clusters (also see competency-mapping inconsistency above).

c2 'See if a friendship goes both ways' (STM-0881) and c15 'Leave room to see if effort comes back' (STM-0532/0533/0538): SAME 'always reach out first -> leave space, see if they reach back' response; differ only by friendship vs romantic context. Overlap worth noting as shared.

Recurring 'set a see-by date, then decide' template appears near-identically across FOUR clusters/phases: c5 'Give another chance only if things really change' (STM-0039/0556), c14 'Set a limit on staying instead of staying by hope' (STM-0318), c11 'Look at what is real' (STM-0689), c24 'Watch over time, then decide' (STM-1039). All share the alternative 'pick what you need to see and by when, then decide.' Note as a shared play family (STM-0039 and STM-0318 are near-identical 'I stay too long' behaviors split across c5/c14).
notes: Reviewed all 81 behavior derivations and 38 candidate Plays across 27 clusters against derivation_rulings.md. Overall the dataset is disciplined: functions stay largely behavioral (refinement 1), Insufficient-Evidence statements correctly get no alternatives and are excluded as behavioral evidence, Likely-Adaptive-Already behaviors are preserved, context conditions and safety carve-outs are present, and reading level is consistently 5th-grade. Maintaining_role and short_term_function were CONSISTENT across duplicate/near-identical statements -- no role flips and no materially different functions were found; the true same-behavior divergences are in competency/task GROUNDING (STM-0446 vs 0704; STM-0055 vs 1085) and in one alternative pair (STM-0449 vs 0985). The single clearest quality defect is STM-0449 (c14): identical to STM-0985 but given an unconditional 'just be honest' alternative that is both inconsistent with 0985 and the closest thing to prohibited generic advice; it stems from the Cross-Phase framework gap (no competency to anchor it), which the author already review_flagged. The most important structural issue is over-consolidation in c5 (pursuit + selection under one new_play, author-flagged) and c11 (waiting + excuse-making), which merge different behavioral targets/responses contrary to refinement 8. Several Plays are effectively duplicated across clusters (c7/c10, c3/c6, c3/c27, c2/c15) plus a recurring 'set-a-deadline-then-decide' family across c5/c11/c14/c24 -- these are coherent but should be noted as shared to avoid divergence during later editing. unsupported_mechanisms is nearly clean; the only items are borderline (fear-attribution in the 'leave before they leave' alternatives).
